title: [YSQL] segfault in ysql backends manager
body:
Jira Link: [DB-9022](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-9022)
### Description

> stress test results for master (2.21.0.0-b271) and there is new tserver core dump in bank workload test
